effect.name: DMG Palette
effect.description: Crushes anything you point it at down to four tones - the original Game Boy screen, by default the same 155/188/15 greens the HUD assets in this repo are drawn on. Optional ordered dithering buys back the gradients four colours cannot hold.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Shade 1 (darkest)
parameter.description: Darkest of the four tones. Default is DMG 15,56,15.

parameter.name: Shade 4 (lightest)
parameter.description: Lightest of the four tones. Default is DMG 155,188,15.

parameter.name: Brightness
parameter.description: Shifts everything up or down the four tones before quantising. Use it to fade a scene to black or white through the palette.

parameter.name: Contrast
parameter.description: Spreads or squeezes the brightness range before quantising.

parameter.name: Dither
parameter.description: 0 is hard banding, 1 is full ordered dithering. Around 0.6 reads as shading rather than noise.

parameter.name: Coarse Dither
parameter.description: On uses a chunky 2x2 pattern, off uses a finer 4x4. Coarse holds up better once the game is scaled up on a big screen.

parameter.name: Amount
parameter.description: Blends the palettised image back over the original, for fading the effect in.
